sections.title: 病位总览
sections.text: 天芮落{palace}，本局{dun}遁，按{sector}先看{primary}。病星本身{illness_power}，{illness_focus}。{external}亦为此宫相应部位，其中{location_focus}。

sections.title: 病宫星门神与条件
sections.text: 病宫见{star_group}，临{door}、{deity}。天芮{illness_power}，{door}之势{door_power}，其象为{door_clue}；{deity}本神{deity_power}，另见{deity_clue}。本宫天地格为{formation}。{void_clue}，{tomb_clue}，{horse_clue}；{restriction_focus}。

sections.title: 天干与细部
sections.text: 病星携{sky}，干力{sky_power}，相应部位另见{secret}；其内在象为{viscera}，外在象为{surface}。地盘{earth}力为{earth_power}，另见{earth_hint}。{companion}。

sections.title: 伤门与病事旁线
sections.text: 伤门落{injury}，临{injury_deity}，门力{injury_power}，{injury_focus}。时干{hour_stem}在{hour_palace}，力为{hour_power}，{hour_focus}。伤门、时干与天芮之间的真实宫位关系分别为{injury_relation}、{hour_relation}。

sections.title: 综合断语
sections.text: 综上，本局主要关注{primary}，{illness_focus}。{secondary_focus}。{external}、{secret}、{viscera}与{surface}中，{location_focus}。这是传统盘象对身体部位的侧重判断，不等于实际疼痛强度或疾病诊断。
